Who we are

Founded in 2005 by two engineers.

We are RCI Engineering. We design mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems and provide commissioning from our office in Davie, Florida. An electrical engineer and a mechanical engineer founded the firm in 2005. Architects, developers and contractors work with us as their in‑house MEP department.

Services

Mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection and commissioning.

Our own engineers draw each discipline and coordinate it with the others before the set is issued. Under each one, what we have designed, from our record.

  • Variable refrigerant flowResidences in Naples and Tallahassee, with refrigerant in small pipes instead of long runs of large duct.

  • Existing buildingsSystems redesigned for a 110-room hotel from 1939 in Miami Beach.
  • Modeled in RevitThe Six13, The Aldridge and The Laramore in Fort Lauderdale.

Questions

Questions architects ask us.

Short answers to the questions we hear at the start of most projects.

What does RCI Engineering do?

We are RCI Engineering. We design the mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems inside buildings and provide commissioning. Architects design the buildings and contractors construct them. We engineer the systems that make them work: air, power, water, fire protection and the controls that tie them together. We were founded in 2005 and work from our office in Davie, Florida.

Where does RCI work?

Our office is at 5599 S University Drive, Suite 204, in Davie, Florida. Most of our work is in South Florida, from Key Biscayne and Miami Beach to Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton and Palm Beach. Our projects also reach Naples, Marco Island, Bonita Springs, Stuart and Tallahassee. Outside Florida, we designed the systems for two university buildings in True Blue, Grenada. Our professional engineers are licensed in multiple states.

What kinds of buildings do you design for?

We organize our work in studios by building type. Our High-end Residential studio designs systems for homes and estates, from a 5,000 sq ft house in Key Biscayne to a residence of more than 26,000 sq ft in Bonita Springs. Our Commercial studio covers luxury retail in the Miami Design District and Palm Beach, restaurants from Miami Beach to Stuart, a hotel renovation in Palm Beach and offices and medical buildings in Hialeah, Little Havana and Boca Raton. Our Multifamily studio runs from six apartments in Bonita Springs to University Pointe in Davie: eight buildings, 280 apartments and more than 700,000 sq ft under air.

When should we bring RCI into a project?

As early as schematic design. Shafts, ceiling heights, equipment locations, roof screens and the electrical service all shape the architecture. Each is easier to place before the plans are fixed. A system decided early can be designed around the architecture. One decided late has to be fitted into it.

How quickly do you respond?

Often within 48 hours, both in design and during construction administration. Every project also runs on structured weekly updates.

Do architects come back to RCI?

They do. Of the 39 projects in our 2026 studio portfolios, 28 came from clients who hired us more than once: eight architecture practices and a custom-home company. One practice brought us six projects from Stuart to Palm Beach: a hotel renovation, three restaurants, a marina kitchen and a retail suite. Another brought luxury retail stores from the Miami Design District to Bal Harbour, Palm Beach and Naples. Homes in Naples, Marco Island, Coral Gables, Miami Beach and Key Biscayne also came from architects who returned.

Mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems and commissioning, designed in Davie, Florida since 2005.
